We need to identify elements based on isotope distribution patterns visible in the mass spectrum. We need the mass spectrum data. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool. Then analyze isotopic patterns to see which elements show characteristic patterns (e.g., Cl with 3:1 ratio, Br with 1:1, S with M+2 ~4% etc). We need to retrieve isotopic distribution for reference. Use retrieve_isotope_distribution.
